home.hero_subtitle: Travel between Douala and Yaoundé in the absolute comfort of premium vehicles limited to 3 passengers. Professional driver and guaranteed air conditioning.
home.intro_p1: VIP Connect is an elite transport agency operating between Douala and Yaoundé. We offer a unique concept in Cameroon: direct trips, without intermediate stops, on board high-end air-conditioned personal vehicles.
home.intro_p2: Each trip is strictly limited to 3 passengers to guarantee generous space and optimal comfort for everyone. No more stress from crowded bus terminals, travel with peace of mind.
home.benefits_subtitle: Why choose the VIP Connect experience?
home.benefit_comfort_desc: Spacious leather seats, adjustable individual air conditioning, and complimentary refreshing drinks.
home.benefit_punctuality_desc: Departures exactly on time. We value your time, and our shuttles never delay.
home.benefit_safety_desc: Experienced professional drivers, geo-tracked vehicles, and systematic traveler identity verification.
home.benefit_booking_desc: Select your slot and choose your exact seat on board in real time.
home.benefit_momo_desc: Pay for your bookings instantly and securely via Orange Money or MTN MoMo.
home.benefit_vehicles_desc: Travel in modern sedans and luxury SUVs that are regularly inspected.
home.testimonials_subtitle: Our travelers' satisfaction is our greatest success
home.destinations_subtitle: Discover our two main hubs through their iconic landmarks
home.dest_yaounde_desc: Find our VIP Connect agency in the city center for a peaceful departure to the political heart of the nation.
home.dest_douala_desc: Travel to or from the busy economic metropolis and major business hub of Cameroon.

kyc.title: Identity Verification
kyc.subtitle: In accordance with regulations for premium inter-city transport, you must verify your identity before making a booking.
kyc.upload_recto: 1. Photo of ID Document (or Front if ID Card)
kyc.data_sec_desc: Your identity documents and selfies are encrypted and securely stored. They are only accessible to the VIP Connect compliance department for validation. Your documents will be automatically purged 30 days after your account becomes inactive, in accordance with personal data protection regulations.
kyc.status_none:
Status: Identity not verified.
Please fill in the information and upload your identity documents to unlock booking services.
kyc.status_pending_redirect:
Status: Verification in progress.
Your identity documents have been submitted and are currently being reviewed by our administrative team. Shuttle booking will be enabled upon account approval.
kyc.status_rejected:
Status: Application rejected.
Reason: {motif}
Please submit clear and correct documents again.
kyc.status_approved:
Status: Identity verified!
Congratulations, your identity has been approved by VIP Connect. You can now book your tickets.

dashboard.showcase_desc: Sit back and relax in our high-end air-conditioned Toyota Corolla vehicles. Direct highway travel, complimentary refreshing drinks. Each trip is limited to a maximum of 3 passengers to ensure your privacy and comfort.
dashboard.book_momo_desc: Payment is processed immediately via Orange Money or MTN MoMo.
